title: Cart Prac
description:
Cart Prac is a Minecraft server with FFA, RTP, Tierlist support, duels and more! Designed for Cart PvP but we also support other explosive game modes! 

Supports Minecraft 1.20-1.21.11
body:
Cart Prac is THE server to practice Cart PvP on, it's made for people who actually want to get better and enjoy time with friends! Doesn't matter if you're a newbie or someone who can double xbows with no problems. There's always someone to queue against and people willing to help you improve! If you're serious about learning Cart PvP and getting good at it this is the server!

Welcome to Cart Prac!


**EU** IP:
> `cartprac.net` || `eu.cartprac.net`(Germany)

**NA East** IP:
> `east.cartprac.net` (NA East) 

**NA West** IP:
> `west.cartprac.net` (California) 

**AS** IP:
> `as.cartprac.net` (Singapore)
